title: Widgets
lead: Use literal key/value content in fixed template positions or reusable ordered sets.

sections.title: Template positions
body: Overview lists positional widgets. Create one by selecting a key discovered from the active template manifest, then enter a plain value and description.
Existing records remain preserved when the active template does not declare their positions. Global identity and contact defaults continue to belong to Global Settings.

sections.title: Reusable content
body: Open Reusable widgets to create stable keys independent of template positions. Values are plain text. Descriptions can label the content in a rendered set.
Open Widget sets, create a stable set key, select members and arrange their display order. Insert the set in Homepage or Pages using the shared component picker.

A plain inline value: {{widgets:value key="example-message" layout="text"}}

sections.title: Recovery and safety
body: Move positional widgets, reusable records or sets to Trash instead of deleting them permanently. Restore them from Trash or restore the catalog from History.
Trashed members are omitted publicly while their references remain recoverable. Exports include live content only. Values never execute HTML, PHP, JavaScript or nested component markers.
